children: Overview
China education provider's interim revenue for six months to June 2026 rose 6.6% yr/yr
Gross profit, profit before tax, and net profit all posted double-digit yr/yr increases
Earnings per share rose to RMB 0.45 from RMB 0.41 yr/yr
Outlook
Shanghai Jian Qiao University plans to enroll 5,526 undergraduates, 810 junior college and 2,114 transfer-program students in 2026/27
Result Drivers
HIGHER STUDENT FEES – Revenue and gross margin benefited from higher average tuition and boarding fees per student
LOWER BORROWING COSTS – Finance costs fell 69.0% after early repayment of most long-term bank borrowings in Q4 2025
ENROLLMENT GROWTH – Full-time student enrollment rose by 254 to 24,182 in the 2025/26 school year
